headline: Interest Rate Worries Drive Money Here… ETF Attracts 1.8 Trillion Won in One Month: What Is It?
summary: Funds are flowing into parking-type ETFs that seek short-term interest income amid high interest rates. Inflows also reflect demand for US stock market exposure.
why: Parking-type ETFs hold short-term instruments and are used to manage cash, so their inflows signal shifts in liquidity and rate expectations. Korean retail and institutional flows also influence local equity and fund markets.
